title: Compact New Image and canvas transparency
summary: Create custom images in a compact dialog, with transparency and white canvas choices inside the color selector.

Improved: New Image follows the observed compact layout with right-aligned pixel fields, canvas swatch, title close and Create/Cancel footer.
Transparent and White canvas choices are available inside the color popup alongside exact RGBA/hex.
Fixed: Closing a nested color popup preserves the New Image draft. Outside clicks retain the modal; Escape cancels only the active layer.
Verified: Native invalid-size guard,320x200 transparent creation and64000 exact clipboard pixels; nested Escape preserves draft dimensions and the existing unsaved image.
86 regular Rust tests, formatting and strict Clippy. Reference Revert/Undo/Redo and576000 restored pixels observed; New Image picker controls added to the UI inventory.

limitations: Full reference canvas-picker, numeric validation, defaults and preference persistence remain unverified; the existing white default is preserved.
Reference repeated Revert adds no-op history and keeps the command enabled; ClipCraft preserves no-op history and disables the redundant action.
Eyedropper, saved color swatches, interactive/off-canvas crop, library history and complete UI parity remain unfinished.
